title: Inside Sales Specialist
jobDescription: About Newage Newage Software & Solutions is a leading provider of Freight Forwarding ERP and Digital Back-Office Services for the global logistics industry. Our end-to-end Saa S-based ERP platform empowers freight forwarders and logistics organizations to streamline operations, improve productivity, reduce operational costs, and gain actionable business insights. Leveraging advanced cloud technologies and automation, our solutions support organizations of all sizes across Sales, Operations, Finance, Documentation, Customer Service, and Accounting. With over 18 years of domain expertise, Newage serves customers across 30+ countries, helping freight forwarding businesses accelerate their digital transformation journey. ‍ About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and customer focused Inside Sales Specialist to support pipeline generation and business growth across India, the Middle East (GCC), and the Americas. The ideal candidate will have experience in B2B Saa S Inside Sales, lead qualification, customer engagement, account research, and Salesforce CRM. This role will work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to engage prospective customers, qualify opportunities, and coordinate meetings that advance the sales pipeline. Rather than focusing on high-volume cold calling, this role emphasizes building meaningful customer conversations, following up on marketing initiatives , nurturing prospects, and supporting strategic account engagement. ‍ Key Responsibilities Engage and qualify prospective customers generated through marketing campaigns, events, referrals, partner channels, and targeted account initiatives. Research target accounts and identify key stakeholders, including CXOs, Business Heads, IT Leaders, and Operations Leaders. Initiate conversations with prospective customers through appropriate communication channels to understand business needs and assess solution fit. Qualify sales opportunities using structured qualification methodologies such as BANT, MEDDICC, or SPIN Selling. Schedule discovery meetings, product demonstrations, and solution discussions for the Sales and Pre-Sales teams. Collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to ensure timely follow-up on inbound enquiries and strategic account opportunities. Maintain accurate customer information, activities, opportunities, and pipeline updates in Salesforce CRM. Support lead nurturing activities by following up with prospects and maintaining ongoing engagement throughout the sales cycle. Conduct market and account research to identify new business opportunities and customer expansion potential. Prepare pipeline reports, sales activity updates, and CRM dashboards for management review. Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly KPIs related to qualified opportunities, meetings scheduled, pipeline contribution, and lead conversion. Stay updated on industry trends, customer challenges, competitor offerings, and developments within the freight forwarding and logistics technology market. ‍ Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Business Development, Sales Development, or Lead Qualification within a B2B Saa S or Enterprise Software environment. Proven experience engaging enterprise customers across India, the Middle East (GCC), North America, and preferably Latin America. Strong experience in customer engagement, opportunity qualification, pipeline management, and supporting enterprise sales teams. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, including Lead & Opportunity Management, Pipeline Tracking, Reports, Dashboards, and CRM hygiene. Familiarity with sales intelligence and account research tools such as Linked In Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Zoom Info, Cognism, Lusha, Lead IQ, Rocket Reach, or similar platforms. Experience working alongside Marketing teams to qualify inbound leads and support account-based sales initiatives. Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage senior business decision-makers. Prior experience in Saa S, Enterprise Software, Freight Forwarding, Logistics, Supply Chain, or ERP solutions will be an added advantage. ‍ Educational Qualification Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA in Marketing, Sales, International Business, or a related field will be an added advantage. ‍

title: WMS Solution Consultant
location: Chennai or Mumbai and Willing to Move Dubai
jobDescription: We are looking for an experienced WMSSolution Consultant with strong expertise in Warehouse Management Systems andcustomer-facing experience. The ideal candidate should have worked in Saa S-based WMS products and possess the ability to understand customer businessprocesses, conduct product demonstrations, provide solution consulting, andsupport pre-sales engagements across logistics and supply chain customers. The role also requires close collaborationwith Product and Business Analysis teams by providing domain guidance, businessprocess inputs, and functional recommendations for continuous WMS productenhancement and development. Key Responsibilities Engage with prospective and existing customers to understand warehouse operations, business challenges, and process requirements. Conduct detailed product demonstrations, workshops, and solution presentations for enterprise customers. Map customer requirements with WMS product capabilities and propose optimized solutions. Work closely with Sales, Product, Business Analysts, and Implementation teams during the pre-sales and solutioning lifecycle. Provide functional guidance and domain expertise to WMS Business Analysts for product development and feature enhancement initiatives. Support Product teams in defining business requirements, operational workflows, and industry best practices for WMS enhancements. Participate in requirement discussions, gap analysis, and product roadmap recommendations. Prepare solution documents, process flows, functional requirement discussions, and proposal responses. Provide domain consulting on warehouse operations including Inbound, outbound, inventory, picking, put-away, replenishment, cycle counting, wave planning, and warehouse automation workflows. Support RFP/RFI responses and customer presentations. Participate in client meetings, business discovery sessions, and solution discussions. Recommend best practices and operational improvements using WMS and logistics technology solutions. Coordinate with implementation teams to ensure smooth transition from pre-sales to project execution. Stay updated on market trends, warehouse automation, supply chain digitization, and Saa S-based logistics technologies. Required Skills Strong experience in Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Experience in Saa S-based logistics or supply chain products. Excellent customer-facing, consulting, and presentation skills. Expertise in conducting product demos and solution workshops. Strong understanding of warehouse operations and supply chain processes. Ability to guide Business Analysts on functional workflows and product requirements. Experience in solution consulting, pre-sales, functional consulting, or product consulting roles. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills. Exposure to integrations, handheld/RF devices, barcode systems, automation, ASRS, or warehouse robotics will be an added advantage. Preferred Background Experience working with WMS Saa S product companies. Prior experience in Logistics, 3PL, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, Distribution, or E-commerce warehousing domain. Exposure to enterprise customer engagements and global implementations preferred. Education Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, IT, or related field. MBA/Supply Chain certifications will be an added advantage. ‍

title: Product Manager – Finance with FF Domain
jobDescription:
About Newage Newage Software (www.newage-global.com) is a leading provider offreight forwarding software and digitized back-office services, designed tomeet the evolving needs of the freight forwarding and logistics industry. Our end-to-end Saa S-based ERPplatform and digital back-office solutions help logistics companies improveoperational efficiency, reduce cost leakages, and gain actionable businessinsights. These solutions leverage advanced technologies and automation tosupport businesses of all sizes—from small and medium enterprises to largeglobal organizations—across functions such as sales, finance, accounting,documentation, and customer operations. With 18+ years of industry expertise,Newage has established itself as a trusted technology partner for freightforwarders and logistics companies across global markets. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with strong expertise in Finance and Freight Forwarding domains todrive the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of our logistics and supplychain technology products. The ideal candidate will bridge business needs,customer expectations, and technology capabilities to deliver innovativesolutions that enhance operational efficiency, financial visibility, andcustomer experience. The role requires deep understandingof freight forwarding operations, finance logistics processes, and Saa S productmanagement practices. ‍ Key Responsibilities ‍ Product Strategy & Roadmap Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Identify market opportunities, industry trends, and customer pain points within freight forwarding and logistics operations. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility. Drive product lifecycle management from concept to launch and continuous enhancement. Serve as the SME for Freight Forwarding
- Finance process globally. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define product solutions. Conduct workshops, product demos, and stakeholder discussions to align business needs with product strategy. ‍ Product Development & Delivery Create PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Partner with Engineering, QA, UX, and Business teams to deliver high-quality product releases using Agile methodologies. ‍ Market & Customer Insights Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, customer feedback, and product usage data to shape product decisions. Evaluate emerging technologies such as AI, automation, and analytics to drive innovation. ‍ Product Performance Define and track product KPIs, adoption, customer satisfaction, and business impact. Continuously improving products through data-driven decision-making and customer feedback. ‍ Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, or related field. MBA preferred. 12+ years of overall experience with at least 5+ years in Product Management. Strong domain expertise in Freight Forwarding, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Transportation Management. Must have strong understanding of logistics finance and accounting processes. Experience working with enterprise Saa S platforms. Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum product development methodologies. Experience writing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. ‍ Preferred Domain Expertise Strong understanding of Freight Forwarding operations including Ocean Freight, Air Freight, NVOCC, Customs Clearance, Shipment Lifecycle Management, TMS, and WMS. Expertise on Finance processes including AP, AR, General Ledger Integration, Revenue Recognition, Cost Accruals, Profitability Management, and Financial Reporting. ‍ Desired Skills Product Strategy and Roadmap Management Saa S Product Development and Agile Methodologies Stakeholder and Customer Management Business Analysis and Process Mapping Data Analytics, Reporting, and API Integrations Strong Communication and Presentation Skills

title: Senior Associate
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Associate Experience: 2 to 4 years Industry: Freight Forwarding Location: Chennai Shift : Day and Night Shift About us : Newage Software ( www.newage-global.com) is well-known for its freight forwarding software and digitized back-office services, which fulfil the ever-changing needs of freight forwarding and logistics industries. Our end-to-end freight forwarding Saa S-based ERP software and digitized back-office services improve operational effectiveness, avoid cost leakage, and provide actionable insights to customers. Our digitized services are based on leading technologies and automation functionality, which work well for all types of companies like small, medium, and large businesses for their sales, finance, accounting, documentation, and customer operations. Newage has been serving customers worldwide for over 18 years and has become the foremost choice in the freight forwarding and logistics industry. Key Accountabilities: • Shipping Documentation: Handle end-to-end shipping import/export documentation back-office process. • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards. • Coordinate with shipping lines and other stakeholders. • Mailbox Management: Manage and oversee assigned mailboxes. • Provide timely responses to email queries. • Client Coordination: Maintain current knowledge of client scope requirements and processes. • Assist in resolving processing issues or customer escalations as they arise. • Provide regular updates to clients on shipment status and other relevant information. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
•

EDUCATION:
Any bachelor's degree, preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain Management. • Experience: 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in freight forwarding, with a focus on export and import shipping documentation and operations. Good knowledge of shipping and logistics concepts, good communication skills, proficiency in email writing. Ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure. ‍
